components.name: ExpandableActionBar
components.doc: Floating action bar: a compact pill of the main actions that grows upward into a labeled grid of every action plus a secondary row, with the icons gliding to their new places.

components.name: ExpandableActionBarPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: select files on a board and act on them from the bar that floats over its bottom edge.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible name: the tile's text when expanded, the button's accessible name when compact.

members.name: primary
members.doc: Primary actions stay visible in the compact pill. Keep them to three or four.

members.name: label
members.doc: Short text at the start of the bar, such as "3 selected". It crossfades when it changes.

members.name: actions
members.doc: Every action, in order. Defaults to sample file actions.

members.name: shortcuts
members.doc: Chips of the secondary row, shown when the bar is expanded. Leave empty to drop the row.

members.name: shortcutsLabel
members.doc: Text before the secondary row's chips.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Whether the bar is expanded. Pass it with `onExpandedChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Whether the bar starts expanded when uncontrolled.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called when the toggle or Escape expands or collapses the bar.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the id of the action that was pressed.

members.name: onShortcut
members.doc: Called with the id of the secondary chip that was pressed.

members.name: width
members.doc: Widest the expanded bar gets, in px. It never grows past the space the component is given.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root box.
